nom: Urban Veda Soothing Ayurvedic Sandalwood & Botanics Exfoliating Facial Polish

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose dry skin used to trigger impetigo, report the polish cleanses without leaving skin dry, with one specifically noting it is moisturizing as well as exfoliating thanks to its creamy texture.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some who also describe their skin as very sensitive, report it leaves skin soft, brightened and not dry, calling it a gentle natural exfoliant well suited to their skin type.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report this is gentle enough to use multiple times a week without redness or irritation, including one whose small areas of eczema looked less red after use; however, one reviewer found the fragrance and exfoliating particles irritating for sensitive skin and returned to a gentler scrub, and another whose sensitive skin reacts even to products labeled sensitive was still cautiously reserving judgment after only two uses.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the polish resolved flaky, dry skin, including one no longer experiencing dryness at all after switching to this product and another whose dry skin used to lead to impetigo; reviewers consistently describe it as hydrating rather than stripping despite being an exfoliant.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness with use, including one whose eczema patches looked less red and irritated and another whose general redness dramatically improved; reviewers prone to redness from harsh products specifically note this one does not trigger that reaction.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers managing skin conditions linked to a compromised barrier, eczema and impetigo triggered by cracking dry skin, report improvement rather than flare-ups after switching to this polish.

aspects.libelle: Distinctive sandalwood fragrance, very strong for a couple of users
Creamy texture with fine particles, gentler than gel scrubs
Good value, a little goes a long way
A couple of sensitive-skin users find it too strong regardless

extraits.texte: The product performs well, has a nice texture, and is a really nice gentle scrub, especially for the price point, but the fragrance is so overwhelmingly strong. I'm not even particularly sensitive to smells, but this is like putting perfume on my face.

This is exfoliating but there is nothing soothing about it. The particles and the fragrance are irritating to sensitive skin. It definitely does a good job exfoliating but I prefer Clinique 7 day scrub which is a lot gentler and which I am going back to after this.
This is the only scrub I can use on my face which doesn't cause me to get dry skin, which ends up with impetigo. Would 100% recommend for someone with dry sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Bubbly, deep cleansing, but very gentle
extraits.texte: Refreshing and soothing upon my delicate skin. I usually hesitate when it comes to choosing a facial wash due to my skin being combination and very sensitive, but this product made my face feel enriched as well as deeply cleansed. I noticed the overall condition and quality of my skin looked visibly better, and the usual small areas of eczema had improved and didn't look red or irritated after use. It's kind to your skin, smells lovely, it isn't over powering or astringent and a little goes a long way due to its thick consistency. I love this brand and I love this range of items.

extraits.titre: Very nice and gentle on skin
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin and this is a game changer for me. The granuales are small and I really feel that my skin is clean and soft. I love the aroma to.

I got a sample of this a few months ago and loved it so bought the full size and it still doesn't disappoint! I have dry skin and this exfoliator is really cleansing but also moisturising as it is creamy with exfoliating particles. It also smells DIVINE!!! love it. Bought the Soothing Day Cream and Facial Oil too!

This facial polish is my holy grail. After using the same products for a good few years I noticed that something changed & my skin was going flaky & really dry. My mum actually recommended that I try something from Urban Veda so I bought this & im so glad that I did! It's so gentle yet you can feel how clean it leaves your face. My redness has dramatically improved & I am no longer flaky or dry!
